## Decisions Ratified Here

These go beyond spec text. Approve or change each; a change becomes a superseding revision.

- **G6. Workspace means the Opportunity Workspace.** In UI copy, "workspace" means only the Opportunity Workspace (spec 989, 1433).
- **G7. Setting, Provider, Capability, and X or Y.** Account preferences are labeled "Setting"; "Preference" stays with the profile construct (Preference or Constraint). "Provider" is always qualified: Sign-in provider, AI provider, Calendar provider. In UI copy, "Capability" means only Share Capability. In "X or Y", the first name is canonical and the second is a label option.
- **G8. Labels for terms the spec leaves unlabeled.** A user-facing term the spec does not label takes its canonical term, a spec 966-974 destination, or its baseline label. Share Capability keeps the baseline "Share link".
- **G9. Software Engineering track names.** System Design, Coding, AI-Assisted Coding, Take-Home, and Behavioral live in a provisional pack.software-engineering namespace, with baseline spellings ("AI Assisted Coding", "Real World Problems", "Real-World Problem", real-world, builder, system) as aliases, until #39 takes the namespace over under pack ID software-engineering.

Terms that follow from them: Sign-in provider (`sign-in-provider`), AI provider (`ai-provider`), Calendar provider (`calendar-provider`), System Design (`track-system-design`), Coding (`track-coding`), AI-Assisted Coding (`track-ai-coding`), Take-Home (`track-take-home`), Behavioral (`track-behavioral`).

## Spec-Change Requests

- **SCR-ROLE. Distinct labels for Opportunity and Engagement.** Spec 1003 labels Opportunity "Opportunity or Role" and spec 418 names the profile construct "Engagement or Role", so "Role" names two things. The owner picks distinct labels; until then both keep "Role" (G5). Cited by #95 (ROUNDS-19-L01), #31 (ROUNDS-05-L01).
- **SCR-SUBMISSION. Add "Submission" to the Career Activity labels.** #88 (ROUNDS-17-L04) and #107 (ROUNDS-22-L02) label material-submission activities "Submission", which spec 1011 ("Interview, Conversation, Follow-up, or Activity") lacks; #107 also has no follow-up kind because #113 uses Actions. labels.ts carries spec 1011 as written until the owner amends it. Cited by #88 (ROUNDS-17-L04), #107 (ROUNDS-22-L02).
